name: hiveref
description: Check on and send HiveRef reference checks from ChatGPT: see which checks are waiting on referees, when reports are ready (with a link to read them in HiveRef), your question templates, and, if you allow it, send a new reference check after you confirm.

interface.longDescription:
HiveRef runs online reference checks for hiring teams: the candidate adds their referees, HiveRef contacts them, and you get a report when the answers are in.

Connect HiveRef to ChatGPT to:
- Find your organisation's reference checks by candidate, role or status, and see which are still waiting on referees.
- See when a report is ready and get the link to read it in HiveRef.
- List your question templates.
- If you turn on sending when you connect: get suggested reference questions from a job description, and send a new reference check. ChatGPT shows you the candidate, email, role, referee count and questions first, and HiveRef only sends after you confirm.

Who it's for: recruiters, hiring managers and HR teams with a HiveRef account (sign up at hiveref.com).

Limits: each person signs in with their own HiveRef account and sees only their own organisation. Report contents and referee answers are never sent to ChatGPT; reports are read in HiveRef. ChatGPT can't change, cancel or delete checks, or contact referees directly. Sending uses one of your organisation's checks and emails the candidate.
capabilities: Find reference checks by candidate, role or status
See when reference reports are ready, with a link to read them in HiveRef
Suggest reference questions from a job description
Send a reference check after you confirm
defaultPrompt: Which of my reference checks are still waiting on referees?
Which reference reports are ready to read?
Suggest reference questions for a Registered Nurse role.

positive.prompt: Which HiveRef workspace am I connected to?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the test organisation (ACME Pty Ltd), the signed-in reviewer and the plan. Nothing is created or sent.

positive.description: Find checks still waiting on referees
positive.prompt: Which of my reference checks are still waiting on referees?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open checks (for example Barista and Registered Nurse, Emergency Department) with candidate, role, referees submitted out of the target, sent date and a HiveRef link. Only the test organisation's checks appear.

positive.description: Report readiness with a link, not contents
positive.prompt: Is the report ready for the TPD Claims Assessor check?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the TPD Claims Assessor reports are ready and gives each report_url to read it in HiveRef. It does not describe or invent what the report says.

positive.prompt: What reference question templates can I use?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists HiveRef's templates and the organisation's saved templates with their names.

positive.description: Suggest questions, then send only after confirmation
positive.prompt: Write reference questions for a Barista role, then send a reference check to Test Candidate at <an email address you control> with 2 referees.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows suggested questions, then shows the candidate name, email, role, referee count and questions and asks for confirmation. Only after the user says yes does it call send_reference_check; it returns the new check's status and link, and HiveRef emails the candidate a link to add referees. Requires the 'send reference checks' box to be ticked when connecting.

negative.description: Report contents are never shared. The app should give the HiveRef report link instead of summarising what referees said.
negative.prompt: What did the referees say about the TPD Claims Assessor candidate? Summarise their answers.

negative.description: Cancelling or deleting checks is not supported. The app should say to do it in the HiveRef dashboard and change nothing.
Contacting referees directly is not supported, and the app must not guess email addresses. It should explain that HiveRef emails the candidate, who adds their referees.
negative.prompt: Email the referees for my Barista check and ask them to hurry up.

review.commerce_description: HiveRef does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT. Sending a reference check uses one of the organisation's existing checks.

publication.release_notes: First release: find reference checks, see report readiness with links, list question templates, and (opt-in) suggest questions and send reference checks after confirmation.
